DAYCARE FOR YOUR FAMILY'S DAY

The warmth of home.
A little longer.

Your child is cared for, not merely supervised. Kabira's daycare gives working families a calm, secure and homely space beyond regular school hours.

A DAY THAT DOESN'T RUSH

Play, rest
and reassurance.

Daycare runs alongside any of our preschool programmes, giving families a dependable place for their child before and after school hours — with the same warmth and attention as the classroom day.

A CALM RHYTHM

A few familiar
moments.

Daycare moves at an easier pace than the school day — enough structure to feel secure, enough calm to feel like home.

  1. 01

    Quiet rest time

    A calm space to nap or unwind, especially for younger children.

  2. 02

    Snack & conversation

    Relaxed mealtimes with gentle supervision and conversation.

  3. 03

    Toys, games and unstructured time to simply be a child.

  4. 04

    Art, stories and quiet activities to round off the day.

DAYCARE QUESTIONS

A few things
you may ask.

What are the daycare timings? +

Daycare is available from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, alongside regular preschool hours of approximately 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM.

Is daycare available for all age groups? +

Daycare can be discussed alongside any of our preschool programmes. Our team can talk through the right arrangement for your family during your enquiry.

Can we use daycare without full-time preschool enrolment? +

Every family's needs are a little different — let us know what you're looking for in your enquiry, and our team will confirm what's possible.
